services.text: Machine polishing that removes swirls and scratches and sharpens your finish.

services.name: Vinyl Wraps

reviews.text: I brought in my brand new 2025 CX-5 to get paint protection film and window tints applied by Mario and the team and they did a flawless job! I’ve had paint protection film done on my other car and in comparison, MADhouse definitely delivered above and beyond. If you want your car taken care of with great attention to detail, this is the place to be.
reviews.name: Michael Medina

reviews.text: This place is awesome! Love the people here. I had a problem with my brake pads making noise due to having another company that spray painted my calipers and Mario was able to diagnose it since Tesla service department wouldn’t. I Highly recommended this place.
reviews.name: Amy Acob
